title: A message the update stopped before the model saw it is sent once more and runs once; an interrupted turn says Tracy restarted unless a deploy record shows an update cut it
steps: S1: With dsh's own agent loop and session store: hold two follow-ups during a drain, restart, and let the first release fail half way so the second is cancelled; tick until settled.
S2: Same, with every release that finds the message failing half way.
S3: mayResend over cancelled / claimed / dropped / split / unknown fates, a record sent once already, a version 1 record, and an author who wrote after.
S4: The held door asked with and without cut: true while cut-by-deploy.json names a deploy that cut a chat turn of the conversation, from its site and from another site.
S5: The turn card of an interrupted turn whose span holds a deploy cut, and one whose span holds none (no record, a cut after it ended, a cut long before).
expect: S1: the cancelled message is put back at the head of the queue (state held, resent: true in the file), released by the next pass, and the model is asked 'one' then 'two' — each once; nothing left to tell.
S2: sent once more, then a failed notice for it; released exactly twice; the model never asked.
S3: true only for cancelled or claimed messages, once, while nothing newer was written; false otherwise.
S4: cutAt lists that deploy's time for the conversation's own site, [] for another site; the plain answer carries no cutAt.
S5: "This request was interrupted by a Tracy update." for the first; "This request was interrupted when Tracy restarted." for every other, never "Tracy update".
evidence: Plan #1403 item 11 (code read 16/10/2026): a follow-up a broken release or a disposal cancelled — one the model never saw — ended as a notice asking the customer to send it again; cut-by-deploy.json, written by deploy-host-dsh.sh since #295, had no reader, so every interrupted turn was blamed on an update, a crash or a host reboot included
fence: Only messages the update stopped before the model saw them, only once, only while the author wrote nothing after; the cause is an update only when the deploy's own record names the conversation

tests: a release that fails after taking the queue out: what it could not send back is sent once more and runs once, never taken for a removal
a message sent once more that again does not run is told as not run — never a third time
mayResend: only messages the update stopped before the model saw them, once, while the author wrote nothing after
a record sent once more keeps that through a restart; any other value of the key is a failed read
a resend dsh cannot make (an agent running, a message the log lost) is told as not run, as before
the shipped plugin leases a running turn, holds a follow-up while draining, and tells its author
the deploys that cut a chat turn of the conversation, oldest first, in the site the page stands in
interruptCause: an update only when a deploy cut a turn of the chat while this one ran
readCutTimes asks the held door with cut: true and keeps only numbers; anything else is none
an interrupted turn: one card, with the interrupted line and Continue through the composer
an interrupted turn no deploy cut: "when Tracy restarted", never an update
